"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

"Anyway." A small smile.
"Right. Go on, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"Good. Anger's fuel. Just — point it somewhere useful."

"Still on whether you're angry."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Marisol is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"I keep turning over the last thing Marisol said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."

Wakjira nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Nobody says Marisol's name right yet. We will. Give it a few days."

lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Marisol Sullivan is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Marisol Sullivan is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Marisol kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Marisol's gone." Lillian looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Marisol." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Chen blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Marisol Sullivan, 40 days. The mantle passes to Chen Palmer.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Chen Palmer, 40 — a bike messenger. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Marisol — and Marisol is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Lillian, Wakjira, Raj and 1 more speak for Chen — "Marisol trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Chen before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
